description: Defines the PaymentDetail entity class for handling payment details within the Fineract project, including fields, constructors, and methods for creating and converting payment detail data.

classes.name: PaymentDetail
classes.description: Entity class representing payment details, with fields for payment type, account number, check number, routing code, receipt number, and bank number, including methods for creation and data conversion.

methods.name: generatePaymentDetail
methods.description: Creates a PaymentDetail instance from a PaymentType and JSON command, updating the changes map with non-blank parameters.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new PaymentDetail instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the PaymentDetail entity to a PaymentDetailData object for external use.
